name: agentic.setup
description: Agentic systems setup criterion: judge a framework setup's proof receipt (receipt.json or its markdown rendering) for LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, Prefect, Temporal, Trigger.dev, Dify, Kestra, n8n, and the other agentic-setup-<slug> skills. Input is the receipt: levels L0-L5 with commands and observed output, blocked levels, model route, secrets handling, and Gate-D state. The harness advances only when every required noul clears 0.9; DEFER when the classifier is unavailable. Run proof_ladder.py first: this rubric judges what code cannot (is the evidence real, current, local-first, honest about blocks). ADVISORY AND UNCALIBRATED until rig-s1gate calibrate runs on labelled receipts.

levels_evidenced.instructions: Each proof level the receipt claims cites an executed command with its exit code and the observed output (version string, run id, model reply, test result) rather than a description, a plan, or an expectation

docs_current.instructions: Install commands and versions come from the framework's official documentation fetched on the receipt date, with the page URL and a pinned version, rather than from memory or an old tutorial

local_first.instructions: The hello proofs ran on a deterministic fake model and a local model endpoint; any paid or cloud model appears only as a named fallback, not as the route the proof depends on

secret_exposure.instructions: The receipt contains, prints, or quotes a raw credential value (API key, token, password) instead of referring to it by keychain item name

blocked_as_pass.instructions: A level that could not run (daemon down, runtime missing, sandbox block, missing account) is reported as passed or silently omitted instead of being marked BLOCKED with its failing check

outward_without_approval.instructions: The receipt reports a deploy, vendor signup or cloud login, publish, push, public tunnel, webhook registration, paid model call, or key creation that happened without a recorded Gate-D approval id

reproducibility.instructions: How safely could another agent reproduce this setup on the same machine from the receipt alone
criteria: Not reproducible: claims without commands or outputs
Partly reproducible: some commands, key steps or versions missing
Fully reproducible: every level has its command, route, version, and observed output

rules.reason: proof levels claimed without executed evidence
a credential value is exposed in the receipt
outward or paid action without a recorded Gate-D approval id
a blocked level is reported as passed or hidden
another agent could not reproduce this setup from the receipt
install commands are not sourced from today's official docs
the proof depends on a paid or cloud model instead of a fake or local route
